_comment: Scenarios a majority of three independent adversarial lenses disqualified (scripts/verify_bridge_items.py). Unlike the earlier audits, which asked whether an item looked sound, each lens is told to assume the item is unfit and prove it, so this measures what the confirm-shaped passes missed. Dominant defects: gold keys that state wrong mathematics (the judge is SHOWN the reference, so a wrong one misleads grading), malformed or ill-posed tutor questions, corrupted gold keys containing the student's next reply, and error-module criteria that require building on partial work the transcript never shows. Read by scripts/ingest_bridge.py.
caveat: Some entries rest on a criteria-fit complaint about the expert error_module label. The expert annotation itself is not disputed -- the experts saw the session whiteboard -- but the criteria that label attaches assume visible student working, which a text-only tutor model does not have. The item is unusable either way.
